summary: Premier healer: dispels and Power Word: Shield make the priest the backbone of a Warsong Gulch premade. Intellect fuels the mana pool for a long flag game while stamina keeps the healer alive under focus.
factionNotes: Racials swing priest value: Dwarf priests (Alliance) bring Fear Ward, a strong counter to the bracket's fear effects, while Undead (Horde) get Will of the Forsaken against fear, charm, and sleep. Verify current racial and spell-rank specifics against the Wowhead Priest guide at authoring.
